sourceNotes: The approved original Service Prices Question 7 includes up to five standard informational pages in the Shopify package; store system screens are additional included templates, not extra informational pages.
The final supplied specification supersedes earlier submission, email, branding-screen and minor-refresh proposals.

publication.notice: Both JSON files are publicly accessible on the static website. They contain selling prices and public rules, not confidential costs, credentials or margins.

tax.display: Before any applicable VAT; tax treatment to be confirmed.
tax.unconfiguredBehavior: Return taxMinor and grossTotalMinor as null. Do not assume a zero VAT rate or add VAT automatically.
tax.configuredBehavior: Use only the company's verified configured tax treatment. Round tax to the nearest penny, half up.

calculationContract.note: Declarative configuration; the consuming static site's client-side renderer/calculator must implement this contract. These files themselves do not execute a form or generate a PDF.
calculationContract.invalidOrNegativeQuantity: validation_error; never coerce, clamp or default to zero
calculationContract.deduplicateBy: Unique price item ID plus work scope; UI selections are unique. Duplicate IDs in imported input are invalid.
calculationContract.knownSubtotalMinor: Sum only priced, non-overlapping, in-scope one-time lines. Included lines have explicit kind=included. Unknown/manual/from amounts never enter this subtotal as zero.
calculationContract.monthlySubtotalMinor: Selected compatible plan only; never add it to the one-time subtotal or payment milestones.
calculationContract.fullTotalMinor: Equals knownSubtotalMinor only when no missing details, pricing review, scope overlap or unsupported requirement remains; otherwise null. This remains an indicative pre-tax estimate, not a contract.

fromPrice.reason: A published starting price is not a confirmed price for this customer's scope.

calculationContract.emptyKnownSubtotalDisplay: No priced items yet — manual quotation required. Never display an unpriced custom application as a £0 project.
calculationContract.customApplication: All selections are requirements for a manual technical quotation. Do not automatically price individual add-ons, apply standard-package inclusions, or generate package milestones for a custom application. knownSubtotalMinor and fullTotalMinor are null until a separately agreed scope is priced.
calculationContract.pendingDisplay: Known priced subtotal only — additional items require review. Full project price pending.
calculationContract.staticReview: Flags are local to the browser/PDF; nothing is sent to FinTaxTech and no staff review is automatically scheduled.

pageRules.count: Unique requested informational pages, including a blog listing if selected. Store system screens and the standard blog article template are excluded.
pageRules.allocation: Every page receives at most one allowance credit of £149; no unused credit is paid out or reused. The formula is independent of page ordering.
pageRules.assessment: Customer chooses page names and describes special needs. Standard layouts are assumed only when explicitly accepted. FinTaxTech determines enhanced/advanced scope; customer special requests remain review items with clearly labelled indicative layout uplifts.
pageRules.blog: Basic/custom blog fee includes the standard article template. Count the blog listing once; if all page slots are used, add one standard informational page, not another template fee.
pageRules.backend: Not covered by any page tier; requires a separate technical quotation.

contentRules.extraWords: Charge whole 500-word blocks explicitly requested in addition to the copywriting allowance; otherwise ask for word count and review. Never charge the first 500 words again.
contentRules.articleWords: £149 covers up to 800 words per article. Longer/specialist/non-English work requires review, not an invented multiple.
contentRules.bundlePolicy: One scoped bundle per service; greater quantities or complex work require review. Do not silently multiply bundles.
reviewWhen: Extra copy without explicit word blocks
contentRules.readySuppliedContent: Placement of approved, ready-to-use material is included; writing, extraction and extensive restructuring are different work.

dependencyRules.onMissing: needs_details; ask whether a new blog or a reviewed existing destination is required
needs_details; do not silently include publishing setup

overlapRules.sameScopeResolution: keep only explicitly selected highest-scope flow; unresolved alternatives require details

overlapRules.resolution: suppress; standard gateway already included; customisations must be described and reviewed
Never infer a page uplift from a paid feature. If a described layout and feature cover the same work, hold disputed lines for review; do not invent a discount or count both.
The newsletter service has one item ID. CRM/API/automation or multiple connectors covering the same workflow require scope review; hold overlapping lines pending a distinct-work assessment.

One optional service may be priced for its defined incremental scope. Two or more potentially overlapping visibility services require review before a combined price; do not simply add list prices. Essentials are never charged again.
Page migration tiers are alternatives. Exclude article/product records from page counts. The same records cannot incur both CSV import and per-product entry; unresolved overlap requires review.
Choose exactly one optional plan. Care/Care Plus already includes compatible hosting; no extra £19 hosting line. Shopify subscription provides store hosting.
Warranty defects and technical work already covered by the selected maintenance plan are never billable as extra minor hours.

shopifyRules.input: Explicit included simple/variable counts plus extra simple/variable counts. Included counts sum to at most 20. Extra entries cannot be charged while allowance remains unused.
shopifyRules.mixedProducts: Ask the customer to identify which listings FinTaxTech should set up first within the 20 included slots; do not silently allocate cheaper or more expensive listings to the allowance.
shopifyRules.csv: One reviewed alternative to manual entry for the same records; not an additional automatic surcharge.
shopifyRules.complex: Complex products need assessment even if they fall within the first 20 listings.
shopifyRules.selfManaged: Customer-added products after handover do not incur FinTaxTech setup fees.
shopifyRules.customFeatures: Standard store checkout/admin is included. Custom checkout, apps, inventory synchronisation or account workflows require technical review.

migrationRules.largerOrUnknown: Requires Review; no automatic batch multiplication
included: Up to 10 standard redirects for a rebuild where technically supported
migrationRules.hostingMigration: £149 only for actually moving an existing compatible website/service, not launching the new build. Shopify platform migration is reviewed.
migrationRules.standaloneDns: £99 catalogue rate retained but hidden in this complete-build journey, because standard domain connection is included.

visibilityRules.recommendationChoice: Requires Review; ask about goals, audience, location and priorities, with no invented automatic price.
visibilityRules.guarantees: No guarantee of rankings, traffic, AI citations or inclusion in generated answers.
visibilityRules.essentialsScope: Foundational website setup; ongoing campaigns and advanced optimisation are separate.

supportRules.qualifyingMinorUpdateMinutes: Exclude warranty defects, included technical maintenance and work outside minor-content/store-update scope before subtracting the allowance.
approvalProcess: Obtain customer approval of scope, rate and limit
Only then perform and bill agreed excess work

unapprovedExcess.display: Additional work requires a separate estimate and approval; no charge authorised.

supportRules.unconfiguredTermsPolicy: Billing increments, rollover, SLA and minimum term were not approved. Do not invent them; agree applicable terms separately. Priority is not a guaranteed response deadline.
supportRules.wholeHourExampleFormula: monthly plan + (qualifying hours minus included hours, floored at 0) * agreed hourly rate; illustrative only until approved
supportRules.majorChanges: New features, redesigns and major changes require a separate quote, not automatic hourly billing.

commercialTerms.milestoneBasis: Agreed one-time project price; recurring and third-party charges are separate. Example milestones use the complete pre-tax estimate only. Final tax treatment follows the agreement/invoice.
commercialTerms.milestoneRounding: Round first two instalments to nearest penny, half up; final instalment is the remainder so they sum exactly to the agreed basis.
commercialTerms.customOrLargeProjects: Price, scope, timeline, revisions and milestone schedule agreed separately after review.

warranty.covers: Defects in FinTaxTech's delivered work against the approved specification

commercialTerms.revisionDefinition: One consolidated set of feedback refining the agreed scope. Fixing an in-scope delivery defect is not a paid revision.
commercialTerms.scopeChanges: Separately scoped, quoted and approved before work or charges.
commercialTerms.timelineQualification: Estimates depend on capacity and complete customer inputs. Customer delays and complex add-ons can move delivery dates; add-on extensions need review, not an invented fixed duration.
customerResponsibilities: Supply and approve content and assets
commercialTerms.ownership: Document ownership, handover and third-party licence restrictions in the customer agreement. Customer owns their domain/platform accounts; no account credentials belong in this configuration or questionnaire.
